create.name: Pamtingpa Center
create.bio:
Pamtingpa Center is a small Tibetan Buddhist centre of the FPMT on rural land outside Tonasket, in north-central Washington State. Su Ianniello started it as a study group in 2003, and with a handful of fellow students it became a registered non-profit and FPMT affiliate in 2009. Lama Zopa Rinpoche consecrated the land in 2010, Yangsi Rinpoche chose the site for its Enlightenment Stupa, finished in 2013, and a meditation hall followed in 2018 and a community room in 2024. Its early teachers included Venerable Yarphel, who led lam-rim study.

Today the centre's regular teacher is Venerable Tenzin Denison, whose Wednesday evening series works through the graduated path with a short teaching followed by guided meditation on the theme, open to newcomers and long-time practitioners, in the hall and on Zoom. Sunday mornings are given to Chenrezig practice and mantra recitation, and a book group meets online. All classes are free, supported by donations, and recordings of past series are posted on its website and YouTube channel.

courses.title: Weekly Wednesday Evening Classes with Venerable Tenzin Denison
courses.description: A weekly class on practising the graduated path to enlightenment: Venerable Tenzin gives a teaching and then leads a meditation on the same topic. Suitable for newcomers and experienced Buddhists, in person or on Zoom.

free_resources.title: 2026 Recordings
free_resources.description: Audio recordings of this year's teaching series at the centre, including a run of talks on deepening a caring heart.

free_resources.title: Approaching the Buddhist Path with Venerable Tenzin
free_resources.description: Recordings of a guided reading, led by Venerable Tenzin, of the first volume of The Library of Wisdom and Compassion by the Dalai Lama and Thubten Chodron.
